overview: Farmer Brain is an AI-powered AgTech platform for farmers, featuring crop management, soil intelligence, live auctions, and multi-language support with a secure login system.
features: Secure phone-based login with protected routes
Guest demo mode for instant access
User profiles with phone, name, location, and language preference
Persistent login session across page refreshes
6-tab dashboard: Home, Soil Intelligence, Crop Planner, Crop Health AI, Digital Mandi, AI Chatbot
Live crop auction with max-bid validation
